memory.vault.disabled: Automatic generation is off (CHATCLI_MEMORY_VAULT); /memory vault sync still writes it on demand.
memory.vault.never: Not synced yet in this session (it syncs a few seconds after memory changes).
memory.vault.kept_hint: Kept (edited by you, or not written by chatcli) — /memory vault sync --force regenerates chatcli's own notes:
mem.cmd.suggest.vault: Obsidian vault of the memory graph (status, sync, path)
mem.cmd.suggest.vault_status: Where the vault is and how the last sync went
mem.cmd.suggest.vault_path: Print the vault directory (open it in Obsidian)
mem.cmd.suggest.vault_force: Also regenerate notes you edited by hand
